outcome_evidence: Frames 31–40 in wrist_left and wrist_right show the spoon retained in the gripper and lifted off the table. Frames 101–105 in wrist_right show the gripper opening and the spoon resting inside the box; ceiling confirms it remains there as the robot withdraws through frame 123.
